name: Crownstar Dragon - Adult
description: Adult Crownstar is a neutral-leaning firmament intelligent true dragon with ivory scales and orbiting star-like crown fragments. It seeks to judge how rulers carry authority. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Regal Claws
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Orbiting Crown
abilities.description: The first ranged attack against the dragon each GM turn has disadvantage.

abilities.name: Coronal Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 19. On a failure, take 3d8+6 magic damage and the target is driven to the ground and becomes Vulnerable until it next acts. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Weight of Authority
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Choose one target within Far range. It must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained by gravity until it escapes with a successful Strength Roll.

abilities.name: The Crown Endures
abilities.description: Once per scene, after an attack damages the dragon, ignore 1 HP it would mark from that attack.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
